explication: PSL is a PHP standard library: a collection of typed, composable APIs for common programming tasks rather than one application with a single mandatory execution path. The README highlights structured concurrency, data validation, functional collections, and async networking; the repository also contains HTTP, TLS, DNS, terminal, crypto, and other domains. The graph represents those capabilities as independent library entry points, with selected internal relationships supported by the README or source index. Several package internals were not sampled, so their connections are intentionally limited.
